description: Read, write, insert, and find-replace text in Google Docs documents.

index.description: Character index to insert at (1 = start of the tab's body)

operation.description: get: get document content and metadata | create: create a new document | write: append text to the end of a document | insertText: insert text at a specific position in a document | replaceText: find and replace text in a document

tabId.description: Tab to act on — a tabId from a previous get's tabIndex. Scopes the read on get; targets the edit on write/insertText/replaceText, which act on the FIRST tab when it is omitted (replaceText spans every tab). Character indices are per-tab.

text.description: Text to write (plain text) — appended to the end by write, inserted at `index` by insertText

name: manage_docs
